model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-AWQ-W4A16 (MTP=0/2); Qwen3.8-27B AWQ (W4A16/W4A8) and EXL3 (MTP=0/2); Qwen3.6-35B-A3B GPTQ (MTP=0/2); DeepSeek-V4-Flash K128
source: Offline-tuned with tools/rdna2_028/tune_prod_shapes.py (>=10 iterations, 25 ms/solver budget, numerical check tolerances 0.01/0.01) on all four GPUs in parallel. Shape list = the union of the committed rows and every GemmTunableOp key observed by the 2026-09-30 record-untuned census over the full serving matrix (4 configs x MTP=0/2; see campaign block). The census replaces the earlier harvest-only derivation: record_untuned records EVERY half-precision GEMM the process issues, so mixed prefill+decode batches (M = 1024+k, 2048+k) that the harvested set never contained are now covered. Curated against fresh same-process heuristic / current / new measurements (tools/rdna2_028/tune_prod_shapes.py --mode measure, GPU 0, 5 warmup + 15 reps median): the chosen solver is whichever condition is fastest, new is adopted only when it beats both current and heuristic by >= 3 %, and rows slower than the heuristic by more than 3 % are dropped. Default rows fold into the dropped set so the shipped file is small and behaviourally identical to the heuristic at those shapes.
validated: 2026-10-10 (coverage): 622 new rows for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B GPTQ MTP=0/2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, 27B EXL3 MTP=2 and 27B AWQ W4A8=1 (>=3% faster than both the current row and the heuristic); additive merge over the 979-row set, no existing row dropped. Lookup-hit proof 1601/1601. Previous: 2026-10-10: Flash-Next mixed prefill/decode expansion. 198 new rows adopted (>=3% faster than both the current row and the rocBLAS heuristic), 2 previously-shipped rows dropped (slower than the heuristic), 104 novel census keys left on the heuristic. Lookup-hit proof 979/979. Prior 783-row set preserved in the campaign work dir (repo-rows-premerge/). Previous: 2026-10-01: EXL3 27B expansion. 29 new rows adopted (21 novel EXL3 K=5120/1536/4352 shapes + 8 small-M decode extensions, each >=3% faster than both current and the rocBLAS heuristic; best 2.35x). 6 previously-shipped rows dropped (fresh measurement 4-7% slower than the heuristic). EXL3 27B rocBLAS fp16 GEMMs are K=5120/1536/4352 and collide with none of the Flash-Next K=2560/320/10240 set (0 collisions, 34 novel captured). MTP=2 not captured (EXL3 MTP head unwired). Lookup-hit proof 783/783. Prior set preserved at repo-rows-premerge/.
storage_policy: One visible folder per rocBLAS build, registered by name in tunableop/profiles.json: name -> {rocblas, rocm, torch, lib_sha256, dir}. This profile (rocm7.14-rocblas5.5, rocBLAS 5.5.0.cd957402) is the canonical shared serving set and covers Flash-Next, 27B AWQ dense and EXL3 27B. configure_tunableop auto-selects it by the loaded librocblas.so.5 sha256[:12]; TUNABLEOP_PROFILE=rocm7.14-rocblas5.5 forces it (validated against the loaded lib). Never store rows in /tmp or the run CWD. Per-user fallback: $HOME/.cache/tunableop/tunableop_results.csv. Consume via tools/rdna2_028/tunableop_env.sh (configure_tunableop). The foreign build lives in the sibling profile rocm10-rocblas5.6.
